svg.title: Nacre data centers — ownership, fiber, and electrical supply
svg.desc: Eight data centers connect to existing telecom metros and fiber routes. Site colors identify joint, telecom, and independent ownership. A separate panel links each facility to its utility distribution area and lists normal and standby feeders.
svg.text: Ownership, fiber access, and electrical supply
Schematic facility sites · Basemap adapted from the Synthetic Exercise World atlas

g.inkscape:label: Facility connections to the electrical grid

g.title: Velkar Distribution Area supplies Basin Compute Campus through E01, E02
Caelum Distribution Area supplies Plateau Colocation through E03
Ilyndor Distribution Area supplies Corridor Exchange Hall through E04, E05
Orinthia Distribution Area supplies Sound Research Vault through E06
Neruva Distribution Area supplies Delta Cloud Campus through E07
Brinax Distribution Area supplies Tideport Colocation through E08
Thyros Distribution Area supplies Steppe Edge Room through E09
Quenari Distribution Area supplies Equator Media Vault through E10

g.text: Normal and standby utility feeders at Basin Compute and Corridor Exchange share their respective distribution area.
